title: Plain names for review rules, evaluators and profiles
summary: No identifier carries its version in its name. The review rules (independent-exact-candidate, operator-exact-candidate), the completion evaluator (completion), the governed and structured profiles, the strict-typing evaluation profile, the package conformance profile and the primary-guide and minting-readiness proof criteria are renamed. New writes use the plain names; stored manifests, sessions, reviews, templates and inventories carrying the original literals (each with its -v1 suffix, and ia.completion.v1) are still read and verified from an explicit allow-list kept for at least one major release; unknown values are still refused.
